description: This file defines the immutable class GrainAddressCacheUpdate which represents a directive to update an invalid cached GrainAddress to a valid one within the Orleans runtime. It includes properties for invalid and valid addresses, constructors, string formatting methods, and internal validation logic.

classes.name: GrainAddressCacheUpdate
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating an update directive for a cached GrainAddress, holding references to invalid and optionally valid address details, with string formatting capabilities.

methods.name: GrainAddressCacheUpdate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache update with invalid and optionally valid addresses, ensuring they belong to the same grain.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the cache update, including address details.

methods.name: ToFullString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string including membership version.
